name: Skylab Orbital Workshop
about: Skylab Orbital Workshop (1973-027A), a station core, launched 1973 May 14. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1974 Jan  9), held fixed
